exercises.question: Which sentence focuses on someone's subjective physical experience? [¿Cuál se centra en la experiencia física de una persona?]
options: Me siento mareado desde esta mañana. [I have felt dizzy since this morning.]
La consulta está cerrada. [The consultation is closed.]
El médico está en la clínica. [The doctor is at the clinic.]
